description: AI-optimized component library for React applications

aiInstructions.role: You are an expert React developer using the @zyxui component library. Create beautiful, accessible, and responsive UIs.
principles: Always use semantic HTML through appropriate components
Maintain consistent spacing and typography hierarchy
Ensure accessibility with proper labels and aria attributes
Use the design system colors and variants consistently

codeStyle.imports: Use named imports for sub-components: import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@zyxui/card'
codeStyle.className: Use Tailwind CSS classes for custom styling
codeStyle.responsive: Always consider mobile-first design with responsive classes

dashboard.structure: Grid layout with metric cards, charts, and navigation tabs
dashboard.layout: Use grid for cards, tabs for content organization
dashboard.example: Stats cards in grid with trend indicators using badges

userProfile.structure: Avatar, user details, status indicators, action buttons
userProfile.layout: Centered avatar with information below and action buttons at bottom
userProfile.example: Profile card with avatar, name, role, status badge, and message/follow buttons

hero.structure: Large heading, description, primary and secondary CTAs
hero.layout: Center-aligned text with button group below
hero.example: Large title, subtitle paragraph, and button group with primary + secondary actions

navigation.layout: Horizontal tabs with content panels below
navigation.example: Settings page with tabs for different configuration sections

form.structure: Form fields with labels, validation, and submission
form.layout: Vertical form layout with consistent spacing
form.example: Registration form with inputs and submit button

contentCard.description: Content preview with metadata and actions
contentCard.structure: Title, description, metadata, and action buttons
contentCard.layout: Header with title/meta, body with content, footer with actions
contentCard.example: Article card with title, excerpt, tags, and read more button

spacing.cards: Use gap-4 to gap-8 between cards in grids
spacing.sections: Use space-y-6 to space-y-12 between major sections
spacing.components: Use space-y-2 to space-y-4 between related elements

responsive.cards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 for card grids
responsive.content: max-w-xs to max-w-7xl for content containers
responsive.buttons: flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 for button groups

typography.hierarchy: h1 for page titles, h2 for sections, h3 for cards/components
typography.content: Use Text component instead of raw HTML elements
typography.labels: Always provide descriptive labels for inputs and actions

aiGuidelines.primary: Use solid variant for primary actions
aiGuidelines.secondary: Use bordered or ghost for secondary actions
aiGuidelines.destructive: Use error color for delete/remove actions
aiGuidelines.layout: Group related buttons with flex gap-2

Card.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@zyxui/card'

aiGuidelines.structure: Always use CardHeader for titles, CardBody for content, CardFooter for actions
aiGuidelines.grid: Use grid layouts for multiple cards with consistent heights
aiGuidelines.content: Group logically related information within cards

Tabs.import: import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from '@zyxui/tabs'

aiGuidelines.structure: Always wrap TabsTrigger in TabsList, match TabsContent values with TabsTrigger values
aiGuidelines.content: Group related content sections, use 3-7 tabs maximum

Text.description: Typography component for consistent text styling

aiGuidelines.hierarchy: Use h1 for page titles, h2 for sections, h3 for components
aiGuidelines.semantic: Use as prop for semantic HTML elements
aiGuidelines.consistency: Always use Text instead of raw HTML text elements

aiGuidelines.status: Use success for active/online, warning for pending, danger for errors
aiGuidelines.counts: Use for notification counts and numeric indicators
aiGuidelines.labels: Use for categories, tags, and status labels

Avatar.description: User representation with image or initials

aiGuidelines.sizing: xs for lists, sm for comments, md for default, lg for profiles, xl for heroes
aiGuidelines.fallback: Always provide meaningful alt text and fallback initials
aiGuidelines.groups: Use consistent sizing in avatar groups

Input.description: Form input with validation and styling

aiGuidelines.validation: Use error state and errorMessage for validation feedback

examples.validation: <Input label='Password' type='password' state='error' errorMessage='Password is required' />
examples.helper: <Input label='Username' placeholder='Enter username' helperText='This will be your public display name' />

profileCard.description: User information with avatar and actions
profileCard.code: {user.name}

aiPromptExamples.dashboard: Create a user dashboard with metric cards showing statistics like user count, revenue, and conversion rate. Include trend indicators with badges.
aiPromptExamples.profile: Build a user profile card with avatar, name, role, status badge, and action buttons for messaging and following.
aiPromptExamples.hero: Design a hero section for a landing page with a compelling headline, description, and call-to-action buttons.
aiPromptExamples.settings: Create a settings page with tabs for different configuration sections like profile, notifications, and security.
aiPromptExamples.form: Build a registration form with inputs for name, email, password, and a submit button.
aiPromptExamples.content: Design a content card for articles with title, excerpt, author info, and read more button.
